process.text: A short chat to understand your goal, audience, and content.
You confirm the scope and package, pay the deposit, and I lock your start date.
You see the layout before I build it, so changes are cheap and fast.
Clean, responsive code with a progress update every few days.
You test the work and send your revisions, included per package.
Final payment, source files, and free bug fixes after launch.

terms.title: Payment
terms.text: 50% deposit to start and 50% before final handover. Projects above 20,000 EGP are split into three milestones: 40%, 30%, 30%.

terms.title: Payment methods
terms.text: Instapay, Vodafone Cash, or bank transfer.

terms.title: Timeline
terms.text: Delivery days start after the deposit and once I receive your content (texts, logo, images). Late content moves the delivery date by the same number of days.

terms.title: Revisions
terms.text: Each package includes a set number of revision rounds. A round is one consolidated list of changes. Extra rounds cost 300 EGP each.

terms.title: Scope changes
terms.text: Anything outside the agreed scope is quoted separately before any work on it starts.

terms.title: Ownership
terms.text: Full ownership of the code and design transfers to you after the final payment.

terms.title: Hosting and domains
terms.text: Domain, hosting, and third-party service fees are paid by you directly. I can deploy for you as an add-on.

terms.title: After launch
terms.text: 14 days of free bug fixes. Bug fixes cover errors in what I built, not new requests.

terms.title: Cancellation
terms.text: If you cancel after kickoff, the deposit is non-refundable and covers the work already done. If I cannot deliver, you get a full refund.

faq.q: Do I need to have my content ready?
faq.a: Yes. Texts, logo, and images are needed before the build starts. I can advise on structure and wording.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my package later?
faq.a: Yes. You pay the price difference and the timeline is adjusted.
Every project is built responsive and tested on phones, tablets, and desktops.
I deploy to hosting that you own, and I can recommend options that fit your budget.

faq.q: What if I need something that is not listed?
faq.a: Send me the idea and I will quote it separately.
